html:
Source contracts: build.sh

build.sh

Shell · Tier B

Launch the native SMTO binary distribution builder on Unix hosts.

Usage

./build.sh [builder options]; arguments pass through unchanged.

Inputs

SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON selects the interpreter; default is python3.

Side effects

exec transfers process ownership to binary_builder.py, which owns downloads, staging, compilation, verification and release outputs. Its downloader prefers curl, then wget, then Python urllib, with SHA-256 checks.

Cleanup

The builder controls --clean/--keep-stage; this wrapper creates no state.

@see scripts/binary_builder.py
